rules: All buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and interactive elements MUST have a unique data-testid.
Never use appearance-based data-testid values like 'red-button'.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Never use generic AI template styles, soft rounded pastel cards, or bright colorful gradients.
Maintain strict dark background contrast (#0A0A0B background with #121214 cards and 1px #27272A borders).
Header must have a solid or dark glassmorphism background with backdrop-blur-md (never 100% transparent drop).
Ensure all interactive states (hover, focus, active) have explicitly set high-contrast text and background states.
Mobile menu must feel custom designed, high-impact, full-screen dark athletic overlay.
Form inputs must send enquiry directly to WhatsApp with pre-formatted professional message.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use React with React Router, Lucide Icons / Heroicons, Lenis for smooth scroll, and Framer Motion for scroll-reveals. Implement all 8 pages seamlessly with data-testid attributes on every interactive element. Ensure the brand identity of Ironblood Fitness Studio and Coach Bapi Das feels world-class, authentic, and dominant.
